From Soft & Wet · Price: a slow bubble that must touch the target.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 1 action: release a bubble that floats in a straight line up to 30 ft. It pops on the first creature or object in that line and steals one property for 1 round: friction (it falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone} if it moves and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 round, @Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates; @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 minute on a critical failure), sound (silenced) or water (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 2} on a critical failure, @Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates; the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened} lasts until it drinks or retches, as normal). Once per turn your stand can pop a bubble on the creature it hits as part of a Strike (1 action), stealing its friction.
  • 5: Bubbles float 40 ft and you release two bubbles per action at different creatures. You can steal sight (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{dazzled} for 1 round on a failure, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{blinded} for 1 round on a critical failure, @Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates). Surge: a single bubble whose stolen property lasts 1 minute; stolen water leaves it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 3} on a critical failure).
  • 9: A surge bubble can steal two properties at once.
  • 13: Your bubbles pass through walls and cover up to 1 ft thick, and ignore cover.
  • 17: Steal the air: the creature is suffocating for 1 round (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
